regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood leads at 32" over the window, with its biggest day Thursday at 17". The NWS is calling for more, 44 to 71 inches Sunday night through Thursday night. A Winter Weather Advisory runs Sunday through Monday night. Sugar Bowl sits at 25" and Palisades at 23".

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth gets 23" with 17" due Thursday. Expect strong southwest wind, with gusts to 60 mph Wednesday night, and wind chill near 12 Sunday night. The NWS is calling for more, 24 to 40 inches Monday through Thursday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler sees 8", mostly Sunday at 7", but it arrives as rain. Winds gust to 40 km/h Sunday morning, and showers continue through Monday. Cypress Mountain gets 4" with a risk of thunderstorms Sunday afternoon. Both turn to sun and cloud midweek.
